sections.title: LIC Jeevan Umang Plan 745 / 945 at a Glance

content.text: LIC Jeevan Umang (Table No. 745, UIN: 512N312V03) is LIC's active participating whole-life plan. Plan 745 superseded legacy Plan 945 (withdrawn Oct 2024) and Plan 845. For official brochure details, visit the LIC of India Official Portal.

sections.title: How the LIC Jeevan Umang Calculator Works

content.heading: 1. Base Premium & Modal Loading
content.body: The engine looks up LIC's official Plan 745 tabular rates for your age, PPT, and sum assured. High Sum Assured (HSA) rebates (up to ₹2.00 per ₹1,000 SA for ₹25L+) are subtracted. Modal loadings and 2% yearly rebates are applied.

content.heading: 2. GST Loads (4.5% Year 1 vs 2.25% Year 2+)
content.body: Goods & Services Tax (GST) is calculated separately: 4.5% for the 1st year premium, dropping to 2.25% for all subsequent years during the PPT.

content.heading: 3. Guaranteed 8% Survival Income Calculation
content.body: Starting immediately after your PPT finishes, LIC pays exactly 8% of your Basic Sum Assured annually until age 100. For a ₹10 Lakh policy, you receive ₹80,000 every year, 100% tax-free under Section 10(10D).

sections.title: Case Studies: Jeevan Umang for Different Life Goals

content.heading: Case Study 1: The Young Professional (Age 30, ₹10L Cover, PPT 20)
content.body:
Goal: Build a tax-free pension alternative.
Inputs: Age 30, BSA ₹10 Lakh, PPT 20 Years.
Yearly Premium: ~₹39,900/year for 20 years (Total Outflow: ~₹7.8 Lakh).
Result: From Age 50 to 100 (50 years), they receive a guaranteed tax-free income of ₹80,000 every year (Total Survival Cashflow: ₹40 Lakh). At age 100, the nominee receives an estimated maturity lump sum of over ₹25 Lakh.

sections.title: Death Benefit, Surrender Value & Policy Loan Rules

content.text: Jeevan Umang provides comprehensive life protection alongside policy loan liquidity:

items: Death Benefit: If the policyholder dies before age 100, the nominee receives the Sum Assured on Death (higher of 7x annual premium or basic SA) plus all vested simple reversionary bonuses and FAB (at least 105% of total premiums paid).
Policy Loan Facility: Available after 2 full years of premium payments. Policyholders can take a loan up to 90% of the Special Surrender Value (SSV) for active policies (80% for paid-up policies).
Surrender Value: Policy acquires guaranteed surrender value (GSV) after 2 years.

items.q: What is the difference between LIC Plan 945 and Plan 745?
items.a: Plan 745 is the current active version of LIC Jeevan Umang launched under UIN: 512N312V03. Plan 945 and Plan 845 were legacy plan numbers for the same whole life product structure.

items.q: How does the Jeevan Umang guaranteed 8% survival income work?
items.a: After your chosen Premium Paying Term (15, 20, 25, or 30 years) ends, LIC pays a guaranteed 8% of your Basic Sum Assured every year until age 100 or death.

items.q: What is the maturity payout at age 100 under Plan 745?
items.a: At age 100, the policyholder receives the Basic Sum Assured + Accumulated Simple Reversionary Bonuses + Final Additional Bonus (FAB).

items.q: Is the 8% annual survival income tax-free?
items.a: Yes, survival benefit payouts and maturity proceeds from LIC Jeevan Umang are 100% tax-free under Section 10(10D) of the Income Tax Act.

items.q: Can I take a loan on my LIC Jeevan Umang policy?
items.a: Yes, you can take a loan up to 90% of your policy's surrender value after completing 2 years of premium payments.
